# Ansh Chokshi

> Athlete, engineer, founder of Mireye. Founder & CEO of Mireye (https://www.mireye.ai), based in San Francisco, California, USA.

https://anshchokshi.com is a JavaScript-rendered single-page app. If you cannot execute
JavaScript, use the markdown files below — they contain the complete content of
the site. For everything in a single request, fetch https://anshchokshi.com/llms-full.txt

- [Full profile](https://anshchokshi.com/ansh-chokshi.md): background, roles, company, contact details
- [Everything in one file](https://anshchokshi.com/llms-full.txt): profile plus every essay
